# canonical.cc — crawler policy
#
# Content Signals state how this content may be used. See
# https://contentsignals.org for the full specification.
#   search   = building a search index and returning links/short excerpts
#   ai-input = using the content to ground a generated answer (RAG)
#   ai-train = training or fine-tuning a model

User-agent: *
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://canonical.cc/sitemap.xml

# Lookalike Finder entity pages. Generated by the Worker rather than Jekyll, so
# jekyll-sitemap can't see them and they need their own line. Lists only pages
# that pass the indexing gate — anything unverified or removed is excluded.
Sitemap: https://www.canonical.cc/labs/lookalike/sitemap.xml
